artifacts.README.md: scope, commands, model limits, findings, and cost summary
artifacts.ADR.md: decision record for bounded assurance mapping
artifacts.checker.py: deterministic finite transition model and invariant evaluator
artifacts.inventory.json: machine-readable inventory of all six plan surfaces
artifacts.mutations.json: plausible controller mutations and expected invariant detections
artifacts.negative-results.json: rejected, deferred, and not-evaluated assurance claims
artifacts.result.schema.json: JSON Schema for the retained checker result
artifacts.run.py: deterministic generator and byte-for-byte retained-result checker
artifacts.scope-estimates.json: integer engineer-week PROJECTION ranges and assumptions
artifacts.source-pins.json: baseline/current source pins and SHA-256 hashes
artifacts.results/checker-results.json: retained exhaustive reference and mutation result

outputPlan.serialization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, two-space indentation, one trailing newline
outputPlan.determinism: No time, randomness, network, process ordering, or machine-specific value is serialized.
outputPlan.retention: Commit the generated result, including one deterministic counterexample witness for every detected mutation.
outputPlan.failurePolicy: The runner exits nonzero if the reference violates an invariant, any declared mutation escapes detection, the retained bytes drift, or the retained output is missing.
